method: Built-in image_gen; transparent alpha preserved for character atlases

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent game sprite atlas for a funny capture sequence in a friendly school cops-and-robbers game. The attached atlas is the exact identity, clothing, proportion and warm storybook ink/shading reference; preserve its blue-uniform policeman and cream-and-black striped, black-cap masked thief. New atlas: exactly THREE equal SQUARE cells in ONE horizontal row, aspect ratio 3:1, real transparent alpha, full body centered in each cell, characters about 84 percent cell height with feet at 92 percent. Cell 1: thief faces front, eyes wide and mouth a small surprised O, BOTH open hands raised beside his head in comic surrender, bent knees, a playful startled hop, no suffering. Cell 2: policeman faces front, broad satisfied grin, chest proud, one hand saluting beside his cap and the other on his hip, both feet planted. Cell 3: thief faces front, sheepish pout, shoulders slumped, BOTH hands resting on cheeks, body crouched slightly in embarrassment, cute and funny. Maintain recognizable exact clothes and matching scale across cells; reserve generous transparent padding around hands and hat. No weapons, cuffs, violence, bars, scenery, ground, shadows, effects, labels, letters, grid borders or cropped limbs. The three poses must be independent isolated cutouts in a precisely regular three-column sprite strip.

assets.promptBrief: Warm, amusing storybook village matching the existing police-and-thieves lobby. assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: production game sprite atlas for the two reference characters STOPPED and STANDING.
